name: Pabili Po!
source:
Nanay has run out of onions for the adobo she’s making! It's up to Bitoy to venture out into the neighborhood and under the hot, hot sun to buy some from the tindahan!

Will Bitoy be able to buy Nanay's onions, or will the events in the neighborhood distract him from his one and only goal?

[from [url=https://rainslices.itch.io/pabili-po]itch.io[/url]]
